# Category: New Publication

## New Publication: Ma Nan’s 马楠 《经学导论》

An Introduction to Classical Studies, by Ma Nan, traces the development of traditional Chinese classical learning (jingxue 經學). The discussion develops along two interconnected lines: the structural characteristics of the classical texts themselves and the traditions of their interpretation throughout successive dynasties.
